senses.gloss:
योषा f. (-षा) A young women.
 E. युष् to serve, sautra root, casual form,
affs. अच् and टाप् ।

योषित् f. (-षित्) A woman in general.
 E. युष् Sautra root, to serve, to
worship, to hurt, इति Unādi aff.; also with टाप् added योषिता f.
(-ता) ।

योषित्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by a woman, contracted by her, &c.
 E. योषिन् कृत done.
